### 📋 Pre-Submission Checklist
Please check the following before submitting:
- [ ] **(Required)** I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/mikroskato62/capy-discord-bot/issues) and [`TODO.md`](../../TODO.md) to ensure this is not a duplicate or already planned.
- [ ] **(Required)** I confirm that this is a constructive proposal and not a joke, spam, or test submission.
- [ ] *(Optional)* I love capybaras!

---

### 🚀 Motivation & Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem this solves or why this feature would be valuable.
Ex. *"It's currently difficult to..."* or *"It would be great to have..."*

### 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what feature, slash command, or improvement you would like to see added.

### 🎮 Command Syntax & Interaction Design *(If applicable)*
- **Proposed Slash Command:** `/capy...`
- **Options / Arguments:** (e.g., `user:@friend`, `category:baby`, `count:3`)
- **Response Format:** (e.g., Rich Embed, Direct Image Attachment, Ephemeral Message)
- **Interactive Elements:** (e.g., Buttons, Dropdown Select Menus, Modals)
- **Permissions Needed:** (e.g., Available to everyone, or Server Admins only)

### 🖼️ Mockups or Visual Concept *(If applicable)*
Paste any visual mockups, embed wireframes, or screenshots showing how it could look.
*(Tip: You can paste images directly into this textbox.)*

### 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, commands, or workarounds you have considered.

### 🌟 Additional Context & Roadmap Reference
Add any other context, references to items in [`TODO.md`](../../TODO.md), or ideas here.
